title: Changed Names Of Some Cities States And Countries
definition: The official alteration of geographical, political, or administrative nomenclature by sovereign states or sub-national entities to reflect decolonization, linguistic reorganization, cultural reclamation, or geopolitical shifts.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in UPSC Prelims (GS-1 Geography & Polity) via direct matching questions of former versus current names, constitutional procedures under Article 3 for states, and global geopolitical toponymic changes.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and constitutional mechanisms of changing names of cities, states, and countries.
Evaluate global and domestic spatial distribution of toponymic changes driven by decolonization and linguistic re-articulation.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions regarding name changes.
prerequisites: Indian Polity: Parliament and State Reorganization (Articles 1-4)
World Regional Geography: Colonial history and sovereign re-identifications
